name: The Pit of Heretics
title: The Pit of Heretics
summary: A stepped ziggurat about 150 m square of red-roofed stone tiers (z 8-45) south-east of Candeth Keep (88.0S 55.0W), crowned by a hall with four portal pillars and a green-blue disc (z 45-52); two statue platforms (35 m discs) 168 m east and west hold the Lord-test statues, and the southern sea lies 200 m to the south-east.

landmarks.name: Summit hall and portal pillars
landmarks.note: 0x010041F5 + Portal Pillars at z 44.6 + disc 0x010041F2 at z 51.6.

landmarks.name: Statue platforms
landmarks.note: Also at (11052,3372); statues are ACE spawns.

site.name: The Pit of Heretics
site.notes: Derived teleport 100 m south-east of the ziggurat on the open sand (the gazetteer Temple Door Portal entry lands on a portal).

shots.standingOrder: Orbit a slow arc 125 m out and 78 m up around the stepped ziggurat with the sun behind; keep 40 m from its tiers.
shots.notes: Signature orbit 125 m out and 78 m up around the stepped ziggurat: the red-roofed tiers, the portal-crowned summit and one of the statue platforms, the southern sea beyond; sun behind. Subject point = the summit hall (its prism is the subject body).
